content: Filistea-dulemar Bab-Dummad-Ulu sesad
A-ibagangine, Israel-sordamar Filistea-sordamargi-bila-onogega nadmalad. Geb Israel-sordamar Eben-Ezerʼye-neg-nugad-dikarba ambikudapmalad. Filistea-sordamardi Afecʼye-neg-nugadgi ambikunonimarmogad.

Filistea-sordamar, Israel-sordamargi bila-onogega duurmakarmargua, Israel-sordamar e-abin duurmakdemarmogad. Agine, Filistea-sordamar, Israel-sordamargi nakwismalad. Bila-onogedgi, Israel-sordamar milibake (4,000) Filistea-sordamarse burgwismalad.

Israel-sordamar na danar-danar bukwadse gannar nonimargu, Israel-girmar-dummagan sogdemalad: “Emi-ibagi, ¿ibiga Bab-Jehová, Filistea-sordamarse-galakuega anmar-imaksa? Degisoggu, Silo-neggweburgi Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu-siid anmar sunae, adi, anmarba gudii guoed, anmar-isdaradmaladgi anmar-bendakegar.”

Degisoggu, girmar-dummagan Silo-neggweburse na e-sordamar-barmisad, adi, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad querubinʼmar-abargi-negdakmaid-e-Ulu sunamalagar. Agine, Elí-masmala-warbogwad Ofni, degi, Finees, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu-edarbedimaladi eba armarmogad.
Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu Israel-sordamar-danar-bukwamaladse selenonigua, Israel-sordamar sabsur-oimakdemalad, neg-dulagwar naded. Abali, napaneg giglimakded.

Filistea-sordamar, Israel-sordamar-oimake itoarmargu, sogdemalad: “¿Ibiga Hebreo-dulemar oimakdemala?” Geb Filistea-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu Israel-sordamar-danar-bukwamaladse selenoniye wisguarmargu, dobgudmalad.
Geb sogdemalad: “Israel-sordamar-danar-bukwadse bab-dummad-gwensak nonikid. ¡Anmar duledar-wilesmar, ar anmar weyob neg-dakdisulid!
¡Anmar duledar-wilesmar! ¿Doa we-bab-dummadgan-bulegangi anmar-bendakoe? Ar we-bab-dummagan nega-dulesulidganba boni-bulegangi Egipto-dulemar-onaglik-gusmaladid.
Degisoggu, ¡Filistea-sordamar! Ar igi Hebreo-dulemar anmar-maiga-gusmala, deyob bemar yapa-gumalale, ¡na be gandik-samar, machered na be san-imakmar, melle-dobgumalo!”

Geb degine, Filistea-sordamar gannar Israel-sordamargi bila-onodmarbalid. Geb bila-onosadgi Israel-sordamargi nakwismarbalid. Agine, Israel-sordamar bukidar-burgwismalad, mili-dulagwen-gakambe (30,000) girgusmalad. Israel-sordamar-durgusmaladdi na e-neg-e-negse wakitemalad.
Degidbali, Filistea-sordamar Elí-masmala-warbogwad Ofni, degi, Finees-nugad, oburgwismalad. Degine, Bab-Jehová-Israel-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu gasmarbalid.
Elí-burgwisad
Sorda-wargwen, Benjamín-yargined, bila-onolenaidgi wakinnargu, Silo-neggweburse mor siir-siir, degi, nono ukub-biini nonikid.

Agine, Elí, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu-selesadba bukib-binsasiid. Degisoggu, gayaburba-wisguegala igar-nagaba gangi siid. A-sorda neggweburse nonigua, bela ibmar-gusad sognonikid. Bela dulemar wisguarmargua, oimakdemalad.
Ar Elí, dulemar-oimakde itoargu, egichialid: —¿Ibiga dulemar oimakdemala? Geb dule-nonikidi, Elíʼga gayaburba-sogega ese abarmakded.
Deunni, Elí birga-dulabake-gakambe-gakabaabak (98) nikad. E-daladi galakudsoggu, geg bar-atakgusad.
Dule-nonikidi, Elíʼga sogded: —Bila-onolenaidgi an emi wakicha-danikid. Elí, ega sogded: —Degite sogdeen, ¿igi ibmar-gusa?

Dule-gayaburba-senonikid abin-sogded: —Israel-sordamar Filistea-sordamar-abin duurmakde gusmalanad, degi-inigwele, bukidar girgusmalad. Be-machimala-warbogwad Ofni, degi, Finees burgwismarmogad. Deginbali, Bab-Dummad-Israel-dulemarbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu galesbalid.

Elí, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu galesye itosgua, gangi-sii yargansik aimukuded, yawagak-nagaba melledapid. Elí, wardummadsoggu, degi, seredgusbarsoggu, aimukudgua, dukar bichisad, yog-burgwar gusad. Elí, birga-dulabo (40) Israel-yargine dulemarga-igar-nabogega megisad.

A-ibagine, Elí-e-bala Finees-ome, bonigwar-gudiid, ugakgued-e-ibagan bato ega warmakdanikid. Finees-ome wisguargua, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu galesye, degi, e-sui burgwisye, e-sak burgwismoye, na e-bonigan itoalid. Na ugakgunaigua, undar-odurdaklenai-gusad.
Muugan-sikwigamalad nue egi-obin-dakarmargua, ega sogdemalad: “Gandik be sae, susugwa bega uklesad.” Finees-ome, muugan-ega-ibmar-sogedi, gwen ega ibmar-soge itosulid, abin-imaksasulid.
Finees-ome, Bab-Dummad-Ulu-galesad-ular, e-sak-burgwisad-ular, degi, e-sui-burgwisad-ular, Icabodʼye e-goe onugsasad. Adi soglegega, Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged nadsunye.
Finees-ome goted: “¡Bab-Dummad-Israel-dulemarbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu galesad! Degisoggu, ¡Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged nadsunnad!”
